transcript: How I started calisthenics in my room. Beginner edition. Push up three sets 10 to 20 reps. If too hard use knees. Chair dips three sets eight to 12 reps. Bend your knees if too hard. Pistol squats do sets five to eight reps. Use a chair if too hard. Extended plank three sets 10 to 20 seconds.
metadata_caption: You must do these if your planning on starting calisthenics in your home! cr:@bgcalisthenicss #calisthenics #beginnerworkouts #foryou
